description: Several small plastic bowls in different shades of blue are sitting on a bedspread in front of a pillow. The left hand stays resting near the bottom left, while the right hand reaches to the darker teal bowl on the right, lifts it, and sets it down into the larger light-blue bowl to make a stack, then the right hand shifts to the lavender bowl and places it on top of another bowl to continue stacking before releasing.
